description: A pollster's final published poll before each election we hold a certified result for, set against that result: share per party or candidate, error in points, mean absolute error, and the error on the winner's margin. Figures come from the pollster's own release or a registry, never an aggregator. Measured facts, not grades: nothing is ranked. Answers "How accurate was Novus in Sweden 2026?". Give a pollster id or name.

pollster.description: Pollster id or name, e.g. "novus" or "Verian"
